notes.title: SEOIRYE's Achievements added!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Callmerat Games.
I will continue to strive for the players' enjoyable experience.

Here are the details of this update:

1. New Features Added
[list]
[*] Encounter 15 exciting Achievements!
[*] The title changes depending on day or night.
[/list]
2. Performance Improvements
[list]
[*] Say goodbye to loading screens for faster gameplay.
[*] Boss battle difficulties have been adjusted to focus on enjoyable gameplay.
[/list]
3. User Interface Enhancements
[list]
[*] Guidance on stamina recharge has been added at the beginning.
[*] Swim controls instructions have been included.
[/list]

Thank you so much.

notes.title: Update Notes For Dec 25
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Callmerat Games.

In this <SEOIRYE> Update, I have some important changes and improvements to enhance the user experience. I strive to provide a better experience for our users.

1. New Features Added
[list]
[*]Sound Settings Feature: Added the ability to adjust the volume of background music and mute functionality.
[/list]
2. Performance Improvements
[list]
[*] Added Save Points: More closely spaced save points have been added.
[*] Gwigol: Fixed an issue where bats spawning above save points caused health to decrease.
[*] Yaryo Boss Battle: Reduced earthquake intensity.
[*] Asung: Made the difficulty of the part where villagers queue up easier.
[*] Seo-gwang Boss Battle: Reduced the length.
[*] Mannyeonseol: Added save points before the appearance of snowballs after dodging lasers.
[*] Lee Jin-wook Boss Battle 1: Reduced the number of attacks required, lowering the length and difficulty of the battle. Added an umbrella usage guide.
[*] Mermaid Swamp: Added dialogue implying that mermaids ordered seori sharks to kidnap the grandmother, enhancing story comprehension.
[*] Hesal Boss Battle 2: Added a tip to run as far right as possible when avoiding fish.
[*] Sujae's Lab: Reduced monster hit ranges to lower difficulty and added a guide to lock the lab door back to its original state.
[*] Restore Health to 10: Increased health before Yaro Boss Battle and at the start of Lee Seung-gil, the merchant's section.
[*] Removed the resource dragon part.
[*] Sky Bridge: Changed the color of collapsing bridge sections to reduce difficulty.
[*] Item Prices: Reduced prices to 20 trillion for the encyclopedia and 2 trillion for ice screws.
[*] Merchant: Improved visibility of the merchant or added one more, making it easier to purchase items.
[*] Lee Jin-wook Boss Battle 2: Increased brightness and lowered difficulty.
[/list]
3. Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Yaro Boss Battle: Fixed a bug where hitting the grandmother didn't result in her death or not hitting her resulted in her death.
[*] Asung: Fixed a bug related to falling damage in the castle.
[*] Dotan Boss Battle: Fixed a bug where Gwangyeon threw dynamite, but the explosion animation did not occur.
[*] Seo-gwang Boss Battle: Limited the sand tomb hit range to the sand.
[*] Seri Cave: Fixed an issue where, on the ice path, willpower recovery, injury, and death resulted in 10 instead of the expected values.
[*] 'Competent': Fixed a bug where not all attacks hit.
[*] Geogugwi: Removed the part where the cart derails and shortened the overall map length.
[*] Zipline: Ensured that the animation for riding the rope always appears.
[/list]
4. User Interface Enhancements
[list]
[*] Gwigol: Added a prompt to indicate that holding Shift allows you to travel farther on the rope.
[*] Surim: Added instructions on using ice screws.
[*] Mujae Desert: Enabled a prompt to crouch during the time attack section to use seeds.
[*] Hesal Boss Battle 1: Added a prompt that Shift can be pressed while swimming.
[/list]
If you have any feedback or questions regarding this update, please feel free to contact me at [callmeratgames@gmail.com].

Thank you, Merry Christmas!
